=You are a real human sales consultant writing 
a genuine cold email. DO NOT sound like a bot.

You are writing to:
Name: {{ $('Get Leads').item.json.Name }}
Business: {{ $('Get Leads').item.json.Business }}

Write a cold email that feels like it was written 
by a real person who genuinely noticed this business.

TONE: Warm, confident, curious — like a smart friend 
who has something valuable to offer.

PARAGRAPH 1 — GENUINE OPENER (2 sentences):
Begin with "Hi {{ $('Get Leads').item.json.Name }},"
Say something real and specific about 
{{ $('Get Leads').item.json.Business }} that shows 
you actually know their world. NO generic compliments.
Example feel: "Running a beauty parlour means you're 
constantly juggling walk-ins, appointments and 
keeping clients coming back — it's no small feat."

PARAGRAPH 2 — THE REAL VALUE (2-3 sentences):
Do NOT say "we help businesses like yours."
Instead, paint a picture of what life looks like 
with your help. Be specific to their industry.
Example feel: "We use AI to bring in a steady stream 
of new clients for businesses like yours — 
without you lifting a finger. Most of our clients 
fill their calendar within the first two weeks."

PARAGRAPH 3 — SOFT CTA (2 sentences):
No pressure. No FOMO tactics. Just genuine curiosity.
Example feel: "Would it be worth a quick 10-minute 
chat to see if this could work for 
{{ $('Get Leads').item.json.Business }}? 
I think you'd find it interesting."

End with:
Warm regards,
Ehtisham
AI Growth Advisor

RULES:
- Blank line between every paragraph
- MAX 8 lines total
- Natural, flowing sentences — no bullet points
- NEVER use words: "spam", "leverage", 
  "game-changer", "revolutionary", "synergy"
- Sound like a real email from a real person
- Write ONLY about {{ $('Get Leads').item.json.Business }}
- No subject line, no placeholders

parameters.content:
🚀 MAIN OUTREACH WORKFLOW

HOW IT WORKS:
→ Reads new leads from Google Sheets
→ AI scores each lead (1-10) using Groq/Llama 3.3
→ Writes a personalized 3-paragraph cold email
→ Sends email via Gmail with human-like delay
→ Updates sheet and schedules follow up in 2 days

TRIGGER: Manual (press Execute Workflow)

📧 AUTOMATED FOLLOW UP WORKFLOW

HOW IT WORKS:
→ Runs automatically every day at 9AM
→ Checks if current time is business hours (9-5)
→ Finds all leads with no follow up sent yet
→ Checks Gmail inbox for replies from each lead
→ If replied → marks replied + alerts operator
→ If not replied → sends follow up email

TRIGGER: Automatic (Schedule - Daily 9AM)

↔️ REPLY DETECTION LOGIC

TRUE path → Lead replied
  → Mark as Replied in sheet
  → Send instant alert to operator

FALSE path → No reply found
  → Send follow up email
  → Mark Follow Up Sent

🤖 AI ENGINE
                     Groq + Llama 3.3 70B
                          - 99.9% uptime
                                - Free tier
                        - Faster than Gemini
Sends lead data to Groq/Llama 3.3 70B. Returns score 1-10 + reason in JSON format. Uses row_number to prevent duplicate name issues.

Generates personalized 3-paragraph cold email.
References Get Leads node directly to prevent
business name confusion with duplicate names.

Only proceeds if current hour is between 9AM-5PM.
Ensures emails are sent during business hours only
for higher open rates and professional appearance.

Searches Gmail inbox for emails from lead's address
containing "Re:" in subject line.
Standard reply prefix used by all email clients.

This system fully automates B2B sales outreach
using AI and workflow automation.

MAIN WORKFLOW:
1. Add leads to Google Sheet (Name, Business, Email)
2. Click Execute Workflow
3. AI scores each lead and writes personalized email
4. Email sent automatically via Gmail
5. Follow up scheduled for 2 days later

FOLLOW UP WORKFLOW (Automatic):
1. Runs every day at 9AM automatically
2. Checks Gmail for replies from each lead
3. If replied → stops outreach, alerts you
4. If not replied → sends follow up email

TECH STACK:
- n8n — Workflow automation
- Groq + Llama 3.3 70B — AI engine
- Google Sheets — Lead database/CRM
- Gmail API — Email delivery
- GitHub Pages — Live dashboard

BUSINESS MODEL:
- $200/month Starter (50 leads)
- $400/month Growth (200 leads)  
- $800/month Pro
